title: Infestation
description: Root out the Swarm infestation, while the Swarm fights for survival and dominance.
npcSpawnRules:
- **Threat Level 1**
	- **1-4:** 2x Desecrator (M)
	- **5:** 2x Desecrator (R)
	- **6:** 1x Ravager
- **Threat Level 2**
	- **1-3:** 3x Desecrator (M)
	- **4-5:** 3x Desecrator (R)
	- **6:** 1x Ravager
- **Threat Level 3**
	- **1:** 4x Desecrator (M)
	- **4-5:** 4x Desecrator (R)
	- **6:** 2x Ravager

missions.title: Breach and Infiltrate
missions.description: The facility's lower levels are sealed. Breach the perimeter to gain access, while the Swarm defends the hatch and denies entry.
missions.setup: Place a Hatch marker in the center of the battlefield.
missions.deployment:
Player Squad deploys before Turn 1 on any battlefield edge.
The Swarm deploys before Turn 1 within 4" of the Hatch marker.
missions.special:
The Hatch is an item with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **4** and may be targeted in Combat.
If the Hatch reaches 0 HIT, it is breached.

**Mission Action: Torch Breach (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Unit that Controls the Hatch may spend 2ACT to remove 1 `HIT` from it.
missions.victory:
- Player Squad wins the Mission if the Hatch is breached before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Swarm wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Destroy the Nests
missions.description: Within the facility, three nests sustain the infestation. Destroy them to cripple the Swarm, while the Swarm must hold at all costs.
missions.setup: Place 3 Spawn Points along the battlefield centerline.
missions.deployment: Both Squads deploy from their Battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
Spawn Points are treated as items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **2**.
Spawn Points cannot be targeted in Ranged Combat if there is at least one Swarm Unit Adjacent to that Spawn Point.
If a Spawn Point is targeted in combat and is not Taken Out as a result of that combat, it regains all of its `HIT`.
missions.victory:
- Player Squad wins the Mission if all three Spawn Points are destroyed before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- Swarm wins the Mission in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Another Way
missions.description: With the direct route blocked, an alternate path must be secured. A control room holds the means to open access, but activation takes time and the defenders will not yield it willingly.
missions.setup: Place 3 Console markers as described in the diagram.
missions.deployment:
The Swarm deploys its Units within 4" of a Console before Turn 1.
Player Squad deploys from the southern edge of the Battlefield before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Activate Console (2ACT)**  
One Unit that Controls a Console may spend 2ACT to Activate that Console.
missions.victory:
- Player Squad wins the Mission if all three Consoles are activated before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- Swarm wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Purge The Infestation
missions.description: Now that the facility's defenses are collapsing, eradicate the remnants of the Swarm while the Swarm must rally for survival.
missions.deployment:
The Swarm deploys within 4" of the northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
Player Squad deploys from the southern edge of the Battlefield before Turn 1.
missions.victory:
- Player Squad wins the Mission if all Swarm Units have been Taken Out by the end of Turn 4.
- The Swarm wins the Mission if at least one Swarm Unit remains Standing by the end of Turn 4.

missions.title: Hold Until Evac
missions.description: The operation has failed. Hold out long enough for extraction, while the Swarm surges from every direction.
missions.setup: Set up terrain to build a partially-enclosed Extraction Zone as a 6" square in the center of the battlefield.
missions.deployment:
Player Squad deploys all Units anywhere within the Extraction Zone before Turn 1.
During Turn 1, when it is a Swarm Unit's Activation, deploy it on any Battlefield edge.
missions.special: Swarm always has the Initative in Turn 1.
missions.victory:
At the end of Turn 4, each Squad adds up the remaining HIT of Standing Units within the Extraction Zone.
The Squad with the highest total wins the Mission.
In case of a tie, the Swarm wins the Mission.
